note: Commercially the closest thing to the stated ICP in this batch: runs a construction business with 81 men under him, treats $6,000 as a big but survivable hit and immediately looked for a write-off, is a strong lifter and surfer who was in the best shape of his life five months ago, and wants to hold and extend that rather than be rescued. The one miss is the criterion that matters most here — his health is not the neglected corner of a good life, it is an active problem with imaging pending, hereditary arthritis and six weeks of forced rest. That is precisely the clinical dimension the stated ICP does not screen for, and this call is the strongest evidence yet that it should.
